automaticky otvorená po prihlásení: true (psst needs this for reliable notifications and calls: Allow notifications, Sound, Lock screen, Banners, Microphone); pred: notifications=off (Missing, Allow notifications, Not allowed yet — turn on to allow); sound=off (Missing, Sound, Allow notifications first); lock_screen=off (Missing, Lock screen, Allow notifications first); banners=off (Missing, Banners, Allow notifications first); callkit=on (Calls via CallKit, Available — an incoming call rings like a phone call, also on the lock screen (CallKit needs no permission)); microphone=off (Missing, Microphone, Not allowed yet — turn on to allow); camera=off (Camera, Not allowed yet — turn on to allow); „Zapnúť všetko potrebné“ + Kamera → 3 systémových výziev povolených; po: notifications=on (Allow notifications, On); sound=on (Sound, On — messages play a sound); lock_screen=on (Lock screen, On — notifications show on the lock screen); banners=on (Banners, On — temporary banners); callkit=on (Calls via CallKit, Available — an incoming call rings like a phone call, also on the lock screen (CallKit needs no permission)); microphone=on (Microphone, Access allowed); camera=on (Camera, Access allowed)
